title: FireTabs Android — maintained general-purpose platform
body: Track the user-selected general-purpose Android platform with a current maintained release-appropriate kernel. Initial hardware is douglas/KFDOWI; Android 17 is the initial target under investigation. Legacy kernels are references. No maintained-kernel firmware is built or booted. Child investigations need source-based evidence before implementation choices are treated as accepted. See projects/firetabs-android/README.md and docs/MAINTENANCE.md.

title: Crestron Panel — optional panel load and runtime compatibility
body: Track the optional selected-application panel load separately from general-purpose Android. Supported Android clients and native panel-runtime compatibility are separate deliverables. Full Home functionality is the lab workload; native parity is unproven. No panel selector or runtime has executed. See projects/crestron-panel/README.md and docs/CRESTRON-PANEL.md.

title: Investigate maintained-kernel and Android 17 integration for douglas
body:
Question: which maintained kernel branch is a plausible basis for douglas with Android 17, and what actual board/driver/interface work is required?

Acceptance: cite current upstream source/config requirements, reusable hardware work and proprietary interface contracts; distinguish verified gaps from hypotheses; recommend a candidate and bounded build experiment with resource estimates. A source audit does not claim compilation, boot or hardware support. No large download or device modification is authorized by this issue.

title: Produce source-cited kernel candidate and hardware support matrix
body:
Bounded first task: identify maintained ACK/kernel candidates and inventory douglas boot, clocks/PMIC, storage, display/touch, graphics and wireless support against actual source. Include ABI/32-bit userspace and Android-required features.

Acceptance: commit an evidence matrix with paths/commits, known missing drivers/contracts, exact unresolved questions and the smallest useful compile test/resource estimate. No kernel branch is preselected by this task.

title: Define full panel-client acceptance and native-service evidence gaps
body:
Build on the actual static APK investigation without claiming the missing service layer works. Keep mobile Home, Go, ONE/web and native runtimes distinct.

Acceptance: a full-function client/processor acceptance matrix and a native dependency inventory with source evidence, missing JNI/localhost services, authorized input options and a bounded first runtime experiment. Record exact lab processor variant/firmware when available. No APK execution or physical changes are implied.

title: Document full-function Home and CP4 test matrix before runtime tests
body:
Define tests for controls/feedback, authentication, video/cameras, audio/intercom, reconnect, processor/tablet restarts, app lifecycle and soak.

Acceptance: a reviewable matrix with exact package identity, required platform/processor versions, evidence to capture, unsupported versus untested behavior and explicit physical authorization boundary. Record unavailable processor details as unknown. This task defines tests, not passing runtime results.

title: Establish public contribution, issue and release governance
body:
Shared repository work requested by the owner, primarily parented here to avoid duplicate epics. Serves both projects.

Acceptance: contributor/security/governance/development docs; independent release numbering and gated cadence; issue forms, native hierarchy, labels and milestones; CI for doc/form/release metadata; explicit license decision or clearly disclosed acceptance hold. No product version is published just because process docs merge.

title: Publish contributor documentation and tested release/issue process
body:
Concrete implementation of the current repository-setup request.

Acceptance: public CONTRIBUTING and supporting docs; seven issue forms; live labels/milestones/native parent links; source-only versus runtime release gates; negative tests and passing CI; private security reporting enabled; owner license selection recorded or external contribution acceptance explicitly held. Close only after documentation and tools are merged to development and actual outputs reviewed.
